units.source_text: 十九小时五十七分，约莫相当于普通对局时间的一倍。

en.t: Nineteen hours and fifty-seven minutes, roughly equivalent to twice the time of an ordinary game.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，按规定时间，名人还剩下二十个小时。

en.t: Even so, by the allotted time limit, the Master still had twenty hours remaining.

units.source_text: 大竹七段即使用时三十四小时十九分，但按四十小时计算，还余下六个小时。

en.t: Even though Otake 7-dan had used thirty-four hours and nineteen minutes, calculated against the forty-hour limit, he still had six hours left.
